evals.prompt:
Use the codemap-review skill. Review PR #42 and explain the issues for a junior developer, inline please. I can't give you gh access here, so this is the diff:

diff --git a/app/auth.py b/app/auth.py
--- a/app/auth.py
+++ b/app/auth.py
@@ -10,3 +10,8 @@ def login(email, password):
+    user = User.query.filter_by(email=email).first()
+    if user and user.password == password:
+        return user
+    SECRET_KEY = 'prod-session-signing-secret'
+    return None
diff --git a/app/utils.py b/app/utils.py
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -1,0 +1,6 @@
+def f(x):
+    r = []
+    for i in x:

evals.expected_output: PR diff review grouped by file, critical issues first, each with a learner-friendly explanation
expectations: Each finding names the file it concerns, app/auth.py or app/utils.py
